name: test-glsl320-builtins
title: GLSL ES 3.20 image atomics, fma and precise
summary: Image atomics (imageAtomicAdd/Min/Max/And/Or/Xor/Exchange/CompSwap on r32ui and r32i, imageAtomicExchange on r32f) with 1024 compute invocations contending for each texel: exact order-independent final values, and every returned value explained by one serial order of the operations (Euler-trail check); a compSwap counter that hands out each value exactly once; an exact single-invocation sequence; invalid (non-existent texel) atomics that return zero; contended adds through uimage2DArray, uimage3D, uimageCube, uimageCubeArray and uimageBuffer. fma() checked against the 'single or two correctly rounded operations' rule and for bit-exact invariance under precise within and across programs; precise a*b+c never fused (six declaration forms), a*b+c*d identical in every operand order, no reassociation. Negative controls for every checker and compile errors for 3.20-only features in #version 310 es and for wrong overloads.
spec: GLSL ES 3.20 §8.12 Image Functions (atomic read-compute-write without intervening modification, r32i / r32ui / r32f-exchange-only rule, IMAGE_PARAMS for 2D, 3D, Cube, Buffer, 2DArray, CubeArray)
GLSL ES 3.20 §8.3 Common Functions (fma: single operation, may differ from a*b+c, invariant when consumed by precise)
GLSL ES 3.20 §4.7.1 Range and Precision (a*b: correctly rounded; a*b+c: correctly rounded single operation or sequence of two; fma inherited; rounding mode undefined)
GLSL ES 3.20 §4.9 The Precise Qualifier (no fma contraction, no reassociation, a*b+c*d identities, operands of a precise assignment, structures, redeclaration, blocks)

GLSL ES 3.20 §4.3.9 Interface Blocks (precise allowed as a block qualifier), §4.10 Memory Qualifiers (r32* images may omit them), §4.1.3 Integers (wrap-around), §5.12 Evaluation of Expressions (reassociation allowed without precise), §6.1 Function Definitions (only a precision qualifier on a return type)
GLSL ES 3.10 §3.7 Keywords (precise reserved), §8 (no fma, no image atomics)

ES 3.2 §8.23 Texture Image Loads and Stores (BindImageTexture, Table 8.25 coordinates, invalid atomics return zero and update nothing), §8.9 Buffer Textures, §7.11.2 Shader Memory Access Synchronization, §17 Compute Shaders

api.glDispatchCompute: 1024 invocations (16 x 64) per atomic dispatch, one invocation per row for the fma/precise programs; every returned word compared with a CPU model
api.glBindImageTexture: R32UI / R32I / R32F 2D textures on units 0-2 (READ_WRITE), and layered (TRUE) R32UI 2D array, 3D, cube and cube-map-array textures and an R32UI buffer texture on unit 0: the atomics' results and the read-back texels come from exactly these textures
api.glTexStorage2D: immutable 4x4 R32UI / R32I / R32F and 2x2 cube R32UI storage used as images (immutable storage is required by BindImageTexture)
api.glTexStorage3D: immutable R32UI 2D array (3 layers), 3D (depth 2) and cube map array (12 layer-faces) storage
api.glTexSubImage2D: initial texels (RED_INTEGER/UNSIGNED_INT, RED_INTEGER/INT, RED/FLOAT and each cube face): counters start at the uploaded bases and texels never addressed read back unchanged
api.glTexSubImage3D: initial texels of the 2D array, 3D and cube map array textures, read back unchanged except the one addressed texel
api.glTexBuffer: R32UI buffer texture over an 8-word buffer; imageAtomicAdd through uimageBuffer updates exactly word 5
api.glMemoryBarrier: SHADER_IMAGE_ACCESS_BARRIER_BIT between the atomic dispatch and the imageLoad dispatch, BUFFER_UPDATE_BARRIER_BIT before mapping
api.glBindBufferBase: SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER bindings 0-3 match layout(binding) of the argument, result and sequence blocks
api.glMapBufferRange: MAP_READ_BIT readback of every shader-written buffer
api.glCompileShader: COMPILE_STATUS false for imageAtomicAdd, fma and precise in #version 310 es, for imageAtomicAdd with int data on a uimage2D and float data on an image2D, and for precise on a function return type; true for the 320 es positive controls

visual_review.notes: gpu es-max capture viewed: uniform black clear, as intended; the test draws nothing, all 83 checks are buffer readbacks and compile statuses.
